Maria - People Ops: FYI — drafted a tiny pack of "growth-focus" feedback snapcards you can paste into self-reviews or manager notes. Short, actionable one-liners + 3 manager follow-ups. Use as-is or adapt. :sparkles:

Maria - People Ops: ```SELF-REVIEW STARTERS:
- "Led X project end-to-end; shipped feature Y; customers report Z improvement; next step: scale + automate."
- "Owned recurring incident response for A; reduced mean time to recover from B -> C; documented runbook."
- "Focused on cross-team collaboration: enabled team D to unblock E by delivering F; result: faster delivery."

MANAGER PRAISE / MANAGER LINES:
- "Consistently delivers dependable work on high-visibility areas; recommend stretch assignment for leadership track."
- "Shows strong technical judgement and tradeoff handling; good mentor for junior engineers."
- "Effectively prioritized scope to hit the milestone while keeping quality acceptable; suggested follow-up: code health pass."

CALIBRATION / CONTEXT NOTES:
- "Impact: measurable (revenue/latency/coverage) or qualitative (removes major blocker for team)."
- "Risk/tradeoff: note speed vs quality choices and mitigation plan."

MANAGER FOLLOW-UPS (paste into 1:1):
- "Can you walk me through the decision tradeoffs on X?" 
- "What support would help you level up to Y?" 
- "Which project would you pick to demonstrate stretch impact next quarter?"
``` 

Ruth (Manager): Love these — short, concrete. Can we add a "cross-team influence" praise line?

Maria - People Ops: added it, pushed an example below.

Maria - People Ops: ```ADDITIONAL ONE-LINERS:
- "Drove cross-team initiative that aligned three teams and removed blockers for release; increased throughput by X%."
- "Mentorship: regularly pairs with new hires and reduces onboarding time; receptive to feedback."
```

Alex (Eng): Nice. Can we include a speed vs quality example? Something like: "Delivered MVP under time constraint, followed with iterative quality sprints and test coverage improvement."

Jamal (PM): :thumbsup: These would make writing reviews way faster. Thanks!
